item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-E007","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In a 3 November 2022 address, Tshisekedi said that more than 200,000 people had been forced to flee fighting in Rutshuru and that he had given the government precise instructions for their gathering and care.","notes":["The excerpt supports the displacement figure, Rutshuru context, attribution of the instructions, and general care, but does not explicitly state that the instructions specified shelter, food, and health support."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-E008","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The same address stated that more than 200,000 people had been forced to flee fighting in Rutshuru and that Tshisekedi had given the government precise instructions for their gathering and care.","notes":["The excerpt supports general gathering and care, but not the narrower claim that the instructions included shelter, food, and health support."]}]}
